title: AssistantConversationResponse
description: Response body of GET /api/assistant-conversations/:id (HEL-663) and POST /api/assistant-conversations (create) -- the summary fields plus the full transcript. The transcript crosses the wire as opaque JSON (an array of ClaudeToolMessage-shaped objects, com.helio.ai) rather than a strictly-typed shape -- see AssistantConversationProtocol.scala's header comment for why. RLS-scoped to the owner; 404 for a missing or non-owned id.
